purpose: Build an on-device Switch probe that initializes the canonical Uniracers ROM through the real SNESRecomp game/runtime path and executes a bounded no-input frame sequence with partitioned simulation digests.
ci_claim: compile/link/package only; execution evidence must come from Switch hardware
non_claims: CI does not prove SnesInit succeeds on hardware
CI does not prove RtlRunFrame completes on hardware
The digest values are observations until compared with retained desktop references
No audio device/thread is created; the no-op APU lock is valid only for this single-threaded probe
Gate S2 is not closed by cross-compilation
